items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Never worked with him. He's great though.

ctx.x: Oh, he's got to answer that.

No. Never worked with him. He's great though. The other movie we just did about six weeks ago, Rings Around the World. You remember the circus show that Don Amici had? Mm-hmm. Well, it's on that style. What they've done, they've gone to France, Spain, and all over the world and filmed different acts in circuses, you know. But Don Amici narrates very little. 85% of the picture is exposed to music. The rest is action. Jack Belasco did this and he's got some beautiful themes going. That man is just going crazy, he…
Al, did you ever have any small little jazz groups?
